style="margin-bottom:11pt"><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">On April 24, 2026, the Annual General Meeting of Hexagon AB (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Hexagon</font><font (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Octave</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221;) to Hexagon&#8217;s shareholders. Shareholders of Hexagon as per the record date May 22, 2026 have received one class A ordinary share in Octave for every ten Series A shares held in Hexagon, and one class B ordinary share in Octave for every ten Series B shares held in Hexagon.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:11pt"><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Non-affiliate holders of Series B shares in Hexagon have received class B ordinary shares in Octave by way of Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB (publ) (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">SEB</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221;) issuing Swedish depository receipts (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">SDRs</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221;). The SDRs each represent one underlying class B ordinary share in Octave and are deposited into shareholders&#8217; Euroclear Sweden accounts.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:11pt"><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Octave&#8217;s SDRs are traded on Nasdaq Stockholm under the ticker symbol &#8220;OCTV SDB&#8221; with the ISIN code SE0028329433. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:11pt"><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Octave&#8217;s class B ordinary shares will be traded on the Nasdaq Stock Market in New York (&#8220;</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Nasdaq New York</font><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221;) under the ticker symbol &#8220;OCTV&#8221; with the ISIN code IE0003YHD8K8 and the CUSIP G22845 104. The first day of regular-way trading in Octave&#8217;s class B ordinary shares on Nasdaq New York is expected to be May 28, 2026.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:11pt"><font style="color:#333333;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Holders of SDRs may cancel their SDRs to receive the underlying class B ordinary shares as early as May 25, 2026, in which case such holders would be expected to receive the underlying class B ordinary shares on May 28, 2026. Conversion is effected through the Octave SDR program and the Euroclear Sweden and Depository Trust Company settlement systems and must be initiated by the bank, broker or other nominee through which the applicable SDRs are held. The holder&#8217;s bank, broker or other nominee will be responsible for transmitting the relevant instructions to SEB, the SDR depositary. Following receipt of a valid conversion instruction, the relevant SDRs will be cancelled, and the corresponding class B ordinary shares will be delivered to the holder&#8217;s designated account. Such conversion will be free of charge during the initial six months from and including the first day of trading in Octave SDRs on Nasdaq Stockholm, and thereafter requires payment of a conversion fee by the holder or its nominee or broker. Holders should contact their bank, broker or other nominee for detailed instructions and timing applicable to their account.</font></div><div><font
